title: Protoboard flight computers
spec: Arduino Nano → Teensy 3.5 · BME280 · MPU6050 · SD logging · hand-wired
summary: Four flight computers for a water rocket, all soldered on protoboard: a servo timer, then altitude logging and apogee detection, then an IMU, then a Teensy 3.5. Each one was built to fix what broke on the last, and the last one ended with a note that I should learn to design PCBs.

cover.alt: Gen 3 flight computer: an Arduino Nano, a microSD adapter and a purple sensor board on blue protoboard
